title: The next step in modernizing Medicaid coverage for exome and genome sequencing
summary: Explore SAVES-Kids research on first-tier exome and genome sequencing, stepwise testing costs, and modeled budget impact for pediatric Medicaid patients.
body_markdown:
Sarah Soto, a board-certified, licensed genetic counselor, began her career as a clinical reproductive genetic counselor. Sarah then transitioned to a number of industry roles, including evaluating preauthorization genetic testing requests for medical necessity at Humana and writing and reviewing Health Technology Assessments—unbiased, evidence-based reviews of genetic tests and their clinical applications – at Hayes.


Most recently, Sarah worked at Myriad Genetics and now at GeneDx, where she focuses on strategy and clinical evidence from the payor perspective for both current and future products. Sarah has lectured at national and international conferences and various genetic counseling training programs on topics related to reproductive genetics or payer coverage and reimbursement.
